outcome: Need for intubation and mechanical ventilation within 72 hours of life
cohort: The study included 36 premature infants with respiratory distress syndrome admitted to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit of the "Santa Maria" Hospital of Terni between 2016 and 2023.
finding: LISA and INSURE were found to be equally effective modalities for surfactant administration, showing similar rates of mechanical ventilation need within 72 hours and comparable major neonatal morbidities in preterm infants with RDS.
